answer_4.quote: We sample 50 tasks from the tasks that our top 10 models got wrong the most. Then, we gather 3 annotations from different annotators and use a majority vote to determine the final preference. All annotators were senior Computer Science PhD students specializing in NLP...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to choose the preferred response between two candidates for each task, using majority vote to decide the final label.
